international.title: Democrat Scott Colom to be first Black senator elected in Mississippi since 1874 after narrow win – US politics live
international.summary: Colom beat Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith after race was called eight days after midterm election day Democrat Scott Colom wins race for US Senate in Mississippi How Colom won deep-red Mississippi with little help from Democrats Sign up for the US Breaking News email Some Democrats, out of the 11 who missed the key procedural vote on Tuesday to impeach Pete Hegseth, blamed a traffic jam in Washington DC for their inability to make it to the US Capitol in time . By a vote of 211-204, Republicans referred the articles of impeachment to the judiciary committee – effectively killing the effort to oust Hegseth. Continue reading...

international.title: Democrat Scott Colom seals historic win in Mississippi Senate race
international.summary: Colom is the first black person from the southern state elected to the US Senate in over 140 years.
